name: smwmusic-mega-man-the-wily-wars-mm2-robot-master-selected-remix
title: Mega Man: The Wily Wars - MM2 Robot Master Selected (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Robot Master Selected theme from Mega Man 2 (specifically based it off the Wily Wars version). There needed to be a newer version of this so I decided to do it. Might do the other Mega Man jingles as well.

Great for stage intros and victories.

There's an option to enable or disable the SMW death SFX at the beginning:
0. No Goal SFX
1. Goal SFX (turned on default)
